title: Celtic Linked With Rangers Midfielder in January Rumour Mill
body:
Celtic are reported to have their eye on a Rangers midfielder, though the story is labelled gossip rather than a deal [S1]. The BBC Sport report puts Celtic among two possible January targets [S1]. The same report says a Turkish club is still interested in the Rangers player, so the Celtic interest is not the only one in play [S1].

That detail matters. Two clubs chasing one player usually means a higher price and a slower process, and a rival with money and a clear interest can change the calculation fast. The report does not say how serious either approach is, so readers should treat every claim as unconfirmed until a club says otherwise [S1].

The material available here offers no form figures or predictions, so there is nothing numerical to test the story against. That leaves the rumour standing on its own, and a rumour standing on its own deserves scepticism.

The smart money is on patience. If a move for this midfielder happens, it should be because the price and the player both make sense, not because a rival's interest forced the pace.

Still, if this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading. A midfield addition from a rival dressing room would be a statement of intent, and fans will be entitled to ask whether it was the right kind of statement.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: Celtic have eye on midfielder Ebonog - gossip. Two possible January targets for Celtic as Turkish club maintain interest in Rangers midfielder...
